$comment: Matrix-bd roles / RBAC model as configurator-ready data. Hand-curated from source; every entry cites path (+ symbol) at the pinned SHA. Route-level guards are machine-extracted in route-guards.json.

roles.label: Business admin
roles.approvalTier: second level (confirm / final sign-off) in almost every module
roles.canSimulate: any role and any module via X-Override-Role / X-Override-Module ("workspace access")

roles.label: Observer
roles.readOnlyEnforcement: get_current_user → _assert_may_write refuses every non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS request keyed on real_role (so an override header cannot lift it)
roles.canSimulate: supervisor or executive only (_OBSERVER_OVERRIDE_ROLES), never business_admin; X-Override-Module scopes module queries
roles.deniedCredentials: require_real_role routes (department join codes, observer code) — reading a join code would allow writes by proxy
roles.onboarding: observer_codes (one live code per tenant) → pending observer → business admin approves
roles.neverAnActor: not allowed in user_module_memberships.role_in_module nor stage_events.actor_role

roles.label: Supervisor
roles.scope: module (via user_module_memberships.module); sees all sites in the tenant for that module
roles.approvalTier: first level review in every module; the ONLY tier in NSO
roles.dualRole: may also work as an executive in its own module when has_executive_access=true (supervisor_executive_requests approved by a business admin); switches with X-Override-Role: executive
roles.onboarding: module_codes (department join code, rotated by business admin) → pending supervisor (users.is_active=false, users.notes='pending_module:<m>') → business admin approves

roles.label: Executive
roles.scope: own: sites they submitted or are assigned/delegated to
roles.approvalTier: capture / upload / submit; in Launch the site creator records a verdict that flows forward
roles.reportsTo: one or more supervisors in the same module (user_module_memberships.supervisor_id, one row per supervisor since 20260818)
roles.onboarding: supervisor_invite_codes (the supervisor's own code) → pending executive → that supervisor approves

guards.require_role(*roles): 403 unless effective role ∈ roles OR role ∈ READ_ALL_ROLES (backend/app/rbac/guards.py)
guards.require_module(name): 403 unless JWT/override module == name OR role ∈ READ_ALL_ROLES (backend/app/rbac/guards.py)
guards.require_real_role(*roles): keys on real_role; NO bypass and NO override — used for credentials (backend/app/rbac/guards.py)
service-level: actor_can_supervise(actor): effective supervisor OR real business admin (backend/app/services/_common.py)
assert_executive_owns_site(actor, site): executives only on submitted_by/assigned_to sites (backend/app/services/_common.py)

per-site delegation checks: shortlist_delegations (BD) and site_delegations(module) for legal/design/project/project_excellence/financial_closure/quality_audit (backend/app/services/delegation_service.py and module services)

_assert_not_self_approval: only callers who CANNOT supervise are blocked from approving/rejecting a draft they submitted; an effective supervisor (or business admin) may approve their own draft — this un-deadlocks the supervisor-simulating-executive flow (backend/app/services/bd_service.py)
supervisor-created drafts start directly at 'shortlisted' (no self-shortlist step) (backend/app/services/bd_service.py svc_create_draft; docs/03-state-machine/site-lifecycle.md)

steps: decode HS256 JWT (aud=authenticated, exp+sub required); app_metadata.role and app_metadata.tenant_id mandatory (403 if absent)
re-read users.role + users.is_active from the DB on EVERY request (role in token is ignored; is_active=false is an immediate kill switch)
claims.role = claims.real_role = DB role; then _apply_workspace_override may change role/module (never real_role)
observer write refusal (_assert_may_write) runs after db.rollback()

headers.X-Override-Role: business_admin → any; observer → supervisor|executive; supervisor with has_executive_access → executive

backend.note: Documentation-grade only: no module outside permissions.py imports it (grep at SHA). Enforcement is route guards + service checks.

frontend.note: Diverges from backend: adds business_admin to create_draft/shortlist/approve_details/reject/archive (backend relies on the READ_ALL bypass instead); lacks send_to_legal and manage_module_team.

noModuleAtAll: finance/CA (BD site tracker Finance tab + business-admin portal)

comparisonWithV5Ceiling.$comment: v5 seedBT().perms is a 'platform ceiling' per action; compare to what the backend actually lets through.

rows.note: route POST /bd/shortlist/{id}/details/save admits both; PERMISSIONS map says executive only
real archive is a supervisor action with a required note; revive restores archived_from_status
the real action is BD supervisor 'send to legal' (LOI_UPLOADED → LEGAL_REVIEW)
budget approval lives in Project Excellence, not Project
launch itself is POST /launch-approvals/{id}/launch by business_admin

comparisonWithV5Ceiling.legend: business_admin* = admitted through the READ_ALL_ROLES bypass / actor_can_supervise, not named in the guard

unmergedWork.summary: Supervisors may BORROW another module's workspace with business-admin approval (supervisor_module_access_grants, migration 20260930). Access is a simulation re-checked per request, not a membership. Also closes invite-code minting for foreign modules. NOT in origin/main — do not treat as current behaviour.
